record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a residual feed-forward block to each GRU output before the unchanged causal pooling: h'=h+W2(GELU(W1(h))), with hidden width 128, W1 Xavier initialized and W2 zero initialized. This starts with the incumbent state transformation while allowing nonlinear refinement within one jointly trained GRU4Rec model per category. Preserve embeddings, pooling, scoring, loss, optimizer and training settings; synchronize checkpoint architecture and predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, add a jointly trained residual GELU feed-forward block of width 128 before the unchanged causal pooling. Xavier-initialize W1 and zero-initialize W2 so the block initially preserves GRU outputs. Retain the GRU backbone, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss, optimizer and training settings.
